purpose: Implement the final canonical public UX/UI for Transparent Price from the approved mockups without changing authoritative business semantics, tenant/role authority, money authority, database authority or security boundaries.
requiredInvariants: Existing backend/API/security/role/tenant/registration/Deal semantics remain authoritative and are not replaced by client state.
The public market remains read-only, anonymised and fail-closed; no fabricated live prices, partners, companies, Deal IDs or integration states are introduced.
Protected /lots, /deals and role-specific cabinet surfaces remain authenticated and role/tenant checked.
The canonical repository logo asset remains the only brand mark.
RU, EN and ZH use one shared design system and the canonical nine roles, seven Deal stages and Trust model.
Visual acceptance uses exact-head production build evidence; no production release occurs before terminal acceptance.
No branch protection, security gate, governance guard or server authority is bypassed.
The canonical /platform-v7 landing does not hydrate hidden legacy contact/support surfaces; login/recovery and older public surfaces retain their existing support behavior.
acceptance: Exact-head web typecheck, unit, Node CI, API and security gates pass.
Canonical visual acceptance passes required screenshots, WCAG 2.2 AA serious/critical checks, runtime-error checks and horizontal-overflow checks.
Responsive acceptance covers 320, 375, 390, 768, 1280 and 1440 widths and RU/EN/ZH public routes.
Lighthouse meets the configured production thresholds and mobile LCP target.
Production is released only after PR acceptance and then manually verified on REG.RU.
